name: Colette Marais
source:
Colette is Elmo’s childhood friend. She has an illness so she’s weak and moves around in a wheelchair. There are two fairies following her around, Jalapeno and Taberuno who are pretty much a two-fairy comedy act. Colette is slightly tsundere and it’s pretty damned obvious she has feelings for Elmo.
